summary: Iteration 7 (Fase 7 – Galleries premium delivery) validated end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 new gallery tests pass (create with new fields type/date/description/session_id/password/cover; rate stars 0..5 with clamp; toggle favorite/selected + 400 on invalid field; comment append + 400 on empty; feature/share/settings regression) + 90/90 regression from iters 1-6 = 104/105 overall (1 AI test intentionally skipped). Frontend (Playwright): all 12 flows pass — Galleries list renders 3 seeded cards (cover/type/name/client/date/photo count/status/lock icon/Abrir); create-dialog with every new testid works and new gallery appears in list; delete works; GalleryDetail (/galerias/:id) hero header renders cover+type+date+title+client with NO 'fmtDate is not defined' runtime error (previously crashed, now fixed); toolbar (Carregar/Exemplo/Seleção IA/Partilhar) + AI search bar + filter chips all present; per-photo action bar pfav/pstar-*-1..5/psel/pcmt/pdl/compare/feature/delete-photo all clickable and photo-comment-input+photo-comment-send inside dialog work; end-to-end persistence verified via GET /api/galleries/{id} (stars=3, favorite=true, selected=true, comments=1). Regression /portal/login and /definicoes still render. No console/pageerror runtime errors captured during entire flow.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iter 6 — `password_hash: ''` field name still leaks in responses because `response_model=Client` refills the projected-out field with its Pydantic default. Fase 7 does not touch this. Fix: return `_public_client(doc)` and drop `response_model=Client`.

No 404 raised when the photo_id does not exist inside the gallery — the endpoint silently no-ops (loops photos, no match, writes back the same photos array). Same behaviour on rate/toggle/feature. Low priority for MVP but should return 404 for unknown pid so the UI/API contract is clear.

action_items: (Carry-over) Fix password_hash leak in /api/clients — return _public_client(doc) instead of relying on response_model=Client.
(Nice-to-have) Return 404 when photo_id is unknown in the rate/toggle/comment/feature endpoints (currently silent no-op).
(Carry-over) Split server.py (~1400 lines) into modular routers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:579-620 — rate_photo / toggle_photo / comment_photo / feature_photo all iterate photos and silently succeed even when photo_id is not present. Consider raising 404 when the pid is not found in `doc['photos']` to surface bugs.

server.py:580 rate_photo — `stars = max(0, min(5, int(body.get('stars', 0))))` correctly clamps AND accepts negative / out-of-range values without a 400. That is intentional per spec ('clamped 0..5') and matches the UI star buttons, but downstream clients relying on 422/400 for invalid values will not get them. Documented, not a bug.
server.py:592 toggle_photo — correctly 400s on invalid field. Good.
server.py:607 comment_photo — correctly 400s on empty/whitespace text. Good.
GalleryDetail.jsx:9 — `fmtDate` is now imported from '@/lib/api'. The previous 'fmtDate is not defined' runtime crash is FIXED and verified in browser (no pageerror captured).

GalleryDetail.jsx:222 — 5 star buttons render 5 sibling <button> in the hover overlay. Rating 0 is not achievable via UI (only 1..5). If a photographer wants to clear a rating, there is no clear-rating button. Minor UX gap; the backend supports stars=0 already, so a small 'X' clear button would complete the flow.

GalleryDetail.jsx:225 — download <a href={p.url} download={p.name}> works for data: URLs (blob) but for cross-origin http(s) images the browser will ignore the `download` attribute and just open the image. This is documented as MOCK by the problem statement — flagging for completeness.
Galleries.jsx:65 — selecting a session prefills type/date/client_name correctly (verified behaviour: gallery-session-select triggers form update). Good.

Galleries.jsx:44 — `remove` uses e.preventDefault() but the delete button is not wrapped in a Link, so preventDefault has no effect; also there is no confirmation dialog before delete. Consider a confirm() or shadcn AlertDialog before destructive action.

Galleries.jsx card layout — the entire card cover area is a <Link>, so clicking anywhere on the image navigates to detail. That is fine, but the Abrir button is redundantly inside another <Link> AND already navigates via router; both are wrapped in <Link to={...}> which nests anchors — React shouldn't nest <a> tags. Consider removing the outer Link from the card and keeping only the Abrir button (or vice versa). Not a runtime error, but semantically invalid HTML.
